stories.title: OU Battle Series Opener Cancelled by Lightning
stories.angle: Oklahoma's fall Battle Series opener at Love's Field on September 30 was cancelled after lightning moved into Norman. The game was moved up 2.5 hours to 4 PM but cancelled 45 minutes into a delay. Ella Parker hit a home run on the very first at-bat, off Audrey Lowry. Next game: October 4 vs. Tarleton State, 1 PM.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text: Lightning cancelled OU's fall opener before it barely started — but Ella Parker already made it memorable. She hit a home run on the very first at-bat off Audrey Lowry. Next up: Oct. 4 vs. Tarleton State at Love's Field. 🥎 #SoonerNation

facebook.long_form:
Oklahoma's fall Battle Series opener got cut short in the worst way — a lightning storm rolled into Norman on September 30, forcing officials to call the game after just 45 minutes of play.

But before the weather had its say, Ella Parker made a statement. On the very first at-bat of the 2026-27 season, Parker launched a home run to right-center field off pitcher Audrey Lowry. A small but electric moment that gave OU fans something to smile about amid the soggy afternoon.

The Sooners had moved the game up 2.5 hours (to 4 PM) in hopes of beating the forecast. It wasn't enough. Lightning made the final call.

Next up for Oklahoma: October 4 at Love's Field, 1 PM — a home exhibition against Tarleton State. If fall ball is any preview of what's coming, it'll be worth the wait.
facebook.image_caption: Lightning couldn't stop Ella Parker from making a statement ⚡🥎 Oklahoma's fall opener was cancelled, but Parker's first-at-bat home run is the only highlight reel anyone needed.

article.headline: Lightning Cancels Oklahoma's Fall Opener, But Ella Parker Stole the Show First

stories.title: Asian Games Day 5 — Japan Perfect Game, Both Japan and China Stay 5-0
stories.angle: Mio Goto threw a perfect game (18 up, 18 down, 9 K, 64 pitches) in Japan's 8-0 six-inning win over Korea on September 30. Japan also beat Singapore 10-0 earlier. Japan and China are both 5-0. Finals are October 3 at Anjō Sports Park — an LA28 Olympic qualifying event.

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Mio Goto just threw a PERFECT GAME at the Asian Games.

18 up. 18 down. 9 strikeouts. 64 pitches. Japan beat Korea 8-0 and is now 5-0.

The Oct. 3 final is shaping up to be one of the biggest softball games of 2026. 🥎

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Japan and China are BOTH 5-0 at the Asian Games.

Chinese Taipei (4-1, World No. 5) could still medal. Finals are Oct. 3 in Anjō — and it's an LA28 Olympic qualifier. The stakes don't get much higher. 🇯🇵🥎 #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Mio Goto just did something extraordinary.

In Japan's 8-0 win over Korea at the Asian Games on September 30, Goto retired all 18 batters she faced. A perfect game. Nine strikeouts. Sixty-four pitches. Not a single baserunner reached.

It was one of two Japan wins on the day. Earlier, Saki Miwa had dominated Singapore in a 10-0 run-rule victory, allowing just one hit over four innings while teammates Hotaru Tsukamoto and Eri Shimoyama each went 2-for-2 with two RBIs.

Japan is now 5-0 at the 20th Asian Games, held at Anjō Sports Park in Anjō, Aichi, Japan. China is also 5-0. Chinese Taipei, the World No. 5 team, sits at 4-1 and is firmly in medal contention.

The stakes couldn't be higher: the October 3 finals at Anjō aren't just for the gold medal — this tournament is part of the LA28 Olympic qualifying pathway. A Japan-China final would be a preview of what the softball world can expect when the sport returns to the Olympics.

Anjō. October 3. Circle the date. 🥎🇯🇵
facebook.image_caption: PERFECT GAME at the Asian Games 🥎🇯🇵 Mio Goto: 18 batters. 18 outs. 9 strikeouts. Japan is 5-0 and rolling toward the Oct. 3 final. This tournament is an LA28 Olympic qualifier — and Japan looks unstoppable.

stories.title: Illinois Names Jenna Hall New Head Softball Coach
stories.angle: Illinois hired former Illini first baseman Jenna Hall — 4x All-Big Ten, 2006 1st-Team All-American, Illinois Athletics Hall of Fame inductee (2019) — as new head softball coach, completing a quick search after releasing Tyra Perry.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Illinois is bringing home one of its own.

Jenna Hall — 4x All-Big Ten, 2006 1st-Team All-American, Illinois Athletics Hall of Famer — is the new head softball coach. A full-circle hire for a program ready for a fresh start. 🧡💙

facebook.long_form:
When Illinois went searching for its next softball head coach, it didn't have to look far.

Jenna Hall is coming home.

A four-time All-Big Ten First Team selection and 2006 First Team All-American during her playing career at Illinois, Hall was inducted into the Illinois Athletics Hall of Fame in 2019. Now she's being handed the keys to the program she helped build.

Hall takes over a team that has struggled badly in recent years — 15-39 overall and 3-20 in the Big Ten during the 2026 season, the third consecutive sub-.500 year under outgoing coach Tyra Perry. But the hire brings a spark of energy and identity back to Champaign.

Hall knows what it means to win in Champaign. Now it's time to show the next generation.
facebook.image_caption: Coming home. 🧡💙 Jenna Hall — four-time All-Big Ten and 2006 All-American — is the new head softball coach at Illinois. The rebuild starts now.

stories.title: Minnesota Names Gretta Melsted New Head Softball Coach
stories.angle: Minnesota hired Gretta Melsted — 20 seasons at Augustana (SD), 813-313 record, 2019 D2 national champion, 14 NCAA Tournament appearances, NFCA Hall of Fame (Dec 2024) — to replace fired Piper Ritter.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Minnesota just hired one of the most decorated coaches in college softball.

Gretta Melsted: 813-313 record. 2019 D2 national title. 14 NCAA Tournaments. NFCA Hall of Famer. Gopher softball has a new chapter. 🐾

facebook.long_form:
Minnesota didn't go looking for a project. They went looking for a proven winner.

And that's exactly what they got.

Gretta Melsted arrives in Minneapolis as one of the most decorated coaches in college softball history. Her 20 seasons at Augustana University (Sioux Falls, SD) produced an 813-313 record, a 2019 Division II national championship, 14 NCAA Tournament appearances, and an NFCA Hall of Fame induction in December 2024.

Melsted replaces Piper Ritter, who was let go in May after a 16-36 season and six years without a return to the NCAA Tournament. The Gophers haven't danced since 2023.

Melsted has never had a losing record at Augustana. That track record, combined with the Big Ten platform and Minnesota's recruiting territory, makes this hire one of the most exciting in the 2026 coaching carousel.

Minnesota is back in business. 🐾
facebook.image_caption: 813 wins. 1 national title. NFCA Hall of Fame. 🐾 Gretta Melsted is the new head softball coach at Minnesota — and Gopher softball has a new chapter starting now.

stories.title: Fall Ball Nation — Programs Set Schedules, Transfer Portal Active
stories.angle: Oregon hosting 8 free fall exhibitions at Jane Sanders Stadium through November 1. Louisiana unveiled a four-game fall slate. Transfer portal: Tori Edwards to LSU, Ella Dodge (Tennessee) to Florida State, 250+ movers tracked by ON3.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Fall ball is officially here.

Oregon is hosting 8 FREE games at Jane Sanders Stadium. Tori Edwards (top-ranked portal transfer) committed to LSU. Tennessee's Ella Dodge is heading to Florida State.

The 2026-27 season is already taking shape. 🥎

facebook.long_form:
Fall ball is in full swing — and the 2026-27 season is already taking shape across the country.

Oregon (Big Ten) is giving fans eight FREE chances to watch the Ducks at Jane Sanders Stadium in Eugene this fall, with games running from October 11 all the way to November 1. Louisiana unveiled a schedule featuring exhibition games against McNeese (Oct. 9) and home contests with Mississippi Gulf Coast and Pearl River on October 14-15.

The transfer portal has been equally busy. Top-ranked transfer Tori Edwards has committed to LSU. Tennessee infielder Ella Dodge is heading to Florida State. Fresno State added three pitchers, a catcher, and an infielder through the portal. The ON3 portal is tracking more than 250 transfers in the 2026 cycle.

This is the time of year when rosters get rebuilt and dynasties get challenged. We'll be tracking it all as programs prep for what's shaping up to be a wild 2026-27 season. 🥎
